blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About West Central Maple Ridge

parts.t: What types of homes are for sale in West Central, Maple Ridge?

Active MLS® listings in West Central typically include established single-family detached homes on large suburban lots (median 9,032 sq ft lot size in Q3 2026), strata townhomes, and low-rise apartment condos between 207 St and 222 St. In Q3 2026, West Central recorded Detached median $1,199,900 ($541/sq ft, 7,318 sq ft lot) · Townhome median $774,900 ($501/sq ft) · Condo median $525,000 ($644/sq ft). Every listing at the top of this page updates automatically from the Greater Vancouver Realtors (GVR) MLS® feed.
Which School District 42 schools serve West Central in Maple Ridge?

Public schools serving or located near West Central include Alouette Elementary (22155 Isaac Crescent, K-7), Glenwood Elementary (21410 Glenwood Ave, K-7), Laity View Elementary (21023 123 Ave, French Immersion), Maple Ridge Secondary (21911 122 Ave, 8-12), and Westview Secondary (20905 Wicklund Ave). Always verify exact street-address catchment boundaries using the official School District 42 (Maple Ridge – Pitt Meadows) locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near West Central?

Residents of West Central enjoy access to Merkley Park (21690 124 Ave), Reg Franklin Park (21358 Dewdney Trunk Rd), Brickwood Park (12162 223 St), and Memorial Peace Park in adjacent Town Centre. See our companion
West Central Neighbourhood Guide
for full park addresses, trail networks, and community recreation details.
How are roads, West Coast Express access, and commuting in West Central?

Primary commuter and road corridors serving West Central include Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Dewdney Trunk Road, Abernethy Way, 207 Street, 216 Street, 222 Street, and Port Haney / Maple Meadows West Coast Express stations, connecting residents to Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Dewdney Trunk Road, the Golden Ears Bridge, and TransLink RapidBus (R3) and West Coast Express commuter rail stations.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or ALR rules apply in West Central?

West Central is shaped by the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan (Bylaw No. 7781-2021, adopted January 27, 2026), the Town Centre Area Plan along 222 St, and Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 on its eastern edge, alongside large RS-1 single-family lots eligible for small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) infill. You can inspect parcel-level setbacks, lot sizes, and suite permissions in our
Maple Ridge Zoning Guide
What are the 2021 Statistics Canada Census demographics for West Central?

According to the 2021 Statistics Canada Census (custom GVR sub-area boundary compilation), West Central has a population of 13,200 across 5,415 occupied private dwellings, a median household income of $96,000, and an owner-occupancy rate of 74%.
